Optional offline overrides for device, endpoint, agent status, SOC 2 monitoring, and availability. Live reports generate agent status and SOC 2 monitoring from Wazuh. Pass this file with --supplemental for previews. Meter rows are [label, achieved, total, kind] where kind is one of ok|warn|bad|blue. 'commentary' is the analyst's written read on the week, shown under the executive summary; wrap paragraphs in

…

and use for emphasis.
commentary:
A steadier week overall. Alert volume rose on the back of a phishing wave targeting finance mailboxes — all quarantined at the gateway, none reached inboxes.

The one item worth your attention: NSO-4821, outbound C2 beaconing blocked at the WAF. The affected host is isolated and under review; no data movement was observed.

device.note: 3 endpoints outstanding (macOS, with client); 3 behind on OS updates — scheduled through Intune this week.

soc2._comment: Feeds the CC7.1 detection row and the control-mapping line; the other criteria rows are built from the report's own incident, agent, vulnerability and availability metrics.
